```
### Manual registration

Manual registration into the addon compartment can be performed by calling the [AddonCompartmentFrame:RegisterAddon](https://www.townlong-yak.com/framexml/live/go/AddonCompartmentMixin:RegisterAddon) function, supplying it a table similar to legacy UIDropDownMenu button initialization.

**MyAddOn.lua**

```
AddonCompartmentFrame : RegisterAddon ({ 
 text = "My Addon" , 
 icon = "Interface \\ Icons \\ TEMP.blp" , 
 notCheckable = true , 
 func = function ( button , menuInputData , menu ) 
 local buttonName = menuInputData . buttonName ; 
 print ( "Hello from the addon compartment! You clicked " .. buttonName .. "!" ) 
 end ,

A new Burning Crusade Classic Patch 2.5.4 Build 42581 revealed interface files for Wrath of the Lich King. Will the Classic title be announced soon?

Blizzard recently pushed a new TBC Classic Patch 2.5.4 Build 42581 and it contains Wrath of the Lich King interface files!  Note that this is a TBC Classic update and the files won't be used in Burning Crusade Classic, but a future Classic product! The following Wrath of the Lich King interface files were discovered:

|* interface\_wrath/framexml/bindings.xml
* interface\_wrath/gluexml/gluebuttons.xml
* interface\_wrath/gluexml/charactercreate.xml
* interface\_wrath/gluexml/charactercreate.lua |
| --- |

When do you think we'll hear more about Wrath Classic? Are you looking forward to it? Let us know in the comments!
